Definition: Channiel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hanniel is a name carried by two Israelites. One is a son of Ulla in Asher, and the other is Hanniel the son of Ephod, the prince of Manasseh who helped divide the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Hanniels show how the same name can sit in a genealogy and in a commission: one is counted, the other is sent to divide the inheritance.
